rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) coverage
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents under its Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260, which the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations enforces. All properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties in Jersey City with 5 or more units; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control. The ordinance also provides certain other exemptions; an owner who meets the criteria may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.citation: Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
